avis.titre: this product was great at first
avis.texte: but then after using it for over a month my whole face broke out!! like pimples all over my nose, forehead, cheeks and jaw line. I'm really sad because it worked great for over a month. I would only use it maybe once a week. the last time I used it I did use more then I usually do, maybe thats why but I rather not use it again just in case.

I wanted to like this product and was hopeful it did what was advertised. However I saw no changes or improvements to my skin. If it was "pore cleansing" this cleansing balm didn't do much for me. This is coming from someone with oily/combo skin. It was a bummer this product fell short and didn't improved my skin over all with the gentle BHA exfoliant. However I hope it is a 5-star hit with you!
This product is very good for my face, don't find many that I can use.

I was on the hunt for the perfect oil cleanser for my oily combo skin. I tried this beacuse of the reviwes and the exfoliation properties intrigued me . This oil cleanser is great because a little goes a long way when wearing minimal makeup and is a total pore cleanser oil cleanser. This saves my skin from the cystic breakouts by deeply cleansing, exfoliating without the dryness. I wouldnt recommend this product for people who have super sensitive skin because of the BHA,if they plan on using it for a daily oil cleanse but if maybe a weekly cleansing. Other than that I believe its sutible for all other skin types.

This has been on my radar for over a year and I finally bought it. NOTHING cleans out my pores the way this does--it was almost gross watching it work at first. My pores have shrunk, my skin feels so much better, and the texture has never been better.

avis.titre: Only used 2x - verdict is still out
avis.texte: I have combo acne prone skin. I used this as the 1st step to remove sunscreen. I followed my regular routine and woke-up with the most greasy face ever. I used my finger and wiped off the oil from my cheek and my fingers were shiny and oily. I could see my shiny cheeks in the mirror as I brushed my teeth. However, this did remove my sunscreen, so there's that.
Absolutely love this. Melts away make up without issues with getting in eyes
The balm is highly effective. Leaves my skin clean. Great price compared to similar products.

I wasn't sure what I was going to expect. I wanted this product to work, but unfortunately it wasn't for me. It felt soft on the skin but immediately after I applied and rinsed with water, my skin was red, almost like I scrub my face with pomade. It was like an allergic reaction. I use the clinique version, and I have never had a skin reaction. I don't think this is good for very sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Love It but Can't Use It
avis.texte: This product was wonderful on smoothing out my forehead texture, and evening out my T Zone. Unfortunately, it also caused almost immediate breakouts in my hairline. I was even extra careful and only used the product on my T Zone, but still got painful bumps in my hairline. I wish I could use this because it does work!!!
it takes off waterproof mascara better than Clinique Take the Day Off or It Cosmetics bye bye makeup. It has a lemony scent but it doesn't bother me.

I have very sensitive skin/ eczema around my eyes and eye makeup remover and cleansing wipes irritate my eyes. This balm removes my waterproof eyeliners and mascaras with no problems and does not irritate my eyes at all. So happy I found this!
I have eczema and rosacea but also produce alot of sebum on my nose. It was good at removing but it broke my skin barrier in other areas.

I got a balm because I felt like one cleanser wasn't taking off enough of my makeup and this was the perfect choice! Almost all of my makeup comes off! This hasn't caused any breakouts and will buy again.

I have older, acne prone skin with large pores. I break out so easily and was nervous to try. I've never double cleansed before. After finishing my first jar my skin hasn't lookes this good in years!!! I really work it in to get into my pores to help dissolve sebum and build up. I follow with Cerave and a low coat vitamin c serum. I swear I took 5-10 years off my face. Not one break out. My pores have cleared out a ton and look smaller for the first time ever. In the last 2 weeks I had 2 separate people compliment me on my complexion. I almost fell over. Me? Good skin?! I'm so grateful!

This is a hidden gem. I was hesitant to buy this because I've never heard this brand before. After using it for 3 months, I love it. It removes the makeup well and moisturizes my face after the wash. I plan on buying this for my mother and sister.

I wanted to like this since I'm a fan of BHA and cleansing balms, but the BHA irritates my skin. I wouldn't recommend this for sensitive skin, or for people who already use exfoliants in other parts of their skincare routine. I prefer having a gentle cleansing balm and going in with actives afterward.

This cleansing balm Takes off makeup and waterproof mascara with ease. I have oily skin and my pores are clogged fairly easily. This balm is so far that works best for my oily skin. I haven't broken out using this.
This is my go to cleansing balm. I love the little spatula which makes it super easy to get just the right amount. It is so satisfying feeling the balm melt as you apply. It's super gentle too.

I returned this balm after one try. It cleansed nothing and removed zero makeup, instead smearing a whitish residue all over my face. Not a pleasant experience in any way. Did I get a bad batch? Regardless, I'll stick with other balms.

avis.titre: Said it's for oily skin but it's great for my dry skin
avis.texte: It's my favorite nighttime face cleanser because it's oily, creamy, nice and not drying at all. I'm surprised it said it's for oily acne prone skin because it leaves my skin with just enough moisture but at the same time deep clean my pores. It's just exactly what I wanted. My skin always feel smooth after use. It will sting your eyelash pores a bit though so I use coconut oil on the eyes to remove makeup first then use this product around my eyes to avoid the stinging sensation in eyelash pores. Overall it's a wonderful product and my holy grail. Please don't discontinue!

My absolute favorite cleansing balm was discontinued so I had to hunt for a new favorite, and I found it with this product! I dont like products woth heavy smells, this one is very light. It does an amazing job of removing my makeup, even better than some I've tried at double the price point. Will be buying this again and again!!!

avis.titre: a little goes a long way on rosacea skin
avis.texte: comes with a little spatula so it doesn't get contaminated. it instantly dissolves into a nice consistency almost like coconut oil but is easy to wipe off with washcloth. no residue, no need to spend forever trying to get it off your face like coconut oil. it says for oily skin but it works really nice on my dry type 1 rosacea without irritating it. I bought it because it came with a free gift and now im hooked and will be buying it again!
I used this for my first step in my skincare for a while. It made me break out so bad.

I've tried a lot of cleansing balms. The green best seller, the zero Ulta best seller, Clinique (which is a close 2nd to this) and the inebriated wildlife. This one is my favorite for several reasons. First, it rinses clean. 2nd, the texture is easy to spread and you don't need much to melt off the day. I use a very thick sunscreen from a medical brand and it is easily removed by this. The BHA is a nice touch, but AHA/BHA need to be on the skin for about 10-15 minutes to work. But I like that it doesn't break me out. I use this as a first step in a double cleanse. I follow with CeraVe cream to foam cleanser and my skin feels great afterwards.

avis.titre: Keep coming back to this one!!
avis.texte: This is hands down my favorite product to use as my 1st step in my double cleanse routine. Removes ALL dirt, oil, makeup, sunscreen, etc!! LOVE IT and will keep repurchasing!!

This is amazing little bit goes a long way it takes up all your make up as a pre-cleanse I usually do a double cleansing I use the bomb followed by a face wash your face foam .I do have acne prone skin I also have sensitive skin I love this I usually follow up with it with the Vici acne control green face wash. Definitely will keep reporting this you have a lot of product for the cost. And a little goes a very long way.
I am very acne prone/oily skin. I feel like this cleans my make up off and has significantly reduced my need to use any acne spot gels.
I was surprised by how much I liked it! My face feels very clean and soft but not dry. Noticed that some of my breakouts flattened overnight. Really don't have any complaints!

I've been using this for a few days and iso far i love it. Its the first step in my skin care routine. This is my first time using a cleansing balm and i really like this. It easily removes my makeup and cleared up a few pimples on my cheeks! I will definitely keep buying this product. Its worth it!

avis.titre: Great consistency and VERY effective for blackheads
avis.texte: I LOVEEEE this balm. I have been using cleansing balms for about 4 years and have tried a few others that I liked, but I gave this one a try because I was trying to incorporate more BHA in my routine to target my blackheads. First of all, I really like this consistency. I'm very particular about that and this consistency is similar to my other preferred balm by heimish, BUT it is also SOOO effective at clearing up blackheads. I've been using it for about 3 weeks and my blackheads have cleared up more than they have with any product I've ever used. I had been using topical salycilic acid and it wasn't doing the trick so I tried a salycilic acid cleanser but found it way too drying, so then I tried this and the difference is very noticeable. I won't say my blackheads are completely eradicated, I think that's an unrealistic expectation, but they are so much less than my usual!!! I'm very very pleased with this purchase.

I have tried quite a few cleansing balms and had problems with all of them lol. Some of them left my face greasy, others made my eyes blurry (!), and one just smelled terrible. This one was none of that! It was effective and gentle and had a light, but non-offensive, fragrance. It doesn't leave my face greasy, just clean and smooth! I received this as a GWP, but will repurchase when I run out.
This is great for my lovely oily skin and fades darks marks and removes black heads while leaving my skin soft and supple 🤗❤️

started using this to take my makeup off at night and it's only been about a week and let me tell you... it's awesome! i have super oily skin and i noticed my skin kinda looking rough due to acne flare ups under the mask and once i started this i immediately noticed my skin felt and looked more hydrated, my acne has calmed down and my pores have shrunk so much. overall my skin looks amazing after adding this to my skincare routine and definitely recommend if you struggle with enlarged pores and/or you're just looking for a cleaning balm to take off your makeup
impressed by the ingrediants and it is HUGE you get so much. yes yes yes

I was watching James Welsh skincare videos and he was raving about balm/oil cleaners so I bought this one first try and WOW I am so happy with my purchase! Will continue using this probably forever lol it's an amazing first step in my nightly skincare routine that just cleanses the entirety of my face of all of my makeup, sunscreen, and sweat that accumulates throughout the day. MAKE SURE YOU DOUBLE CLEANSE AFTER USING THIS PRODUCT. After I rinse this off of my face I immediately go in with my cerave hydrating cleanser just to make sure i got all of the balm and anything left behind.

I am very satisfied with this cleansing balm. I have oily, acne prone skin and use this balm as part of a double cleanse. The balm is very effective at removing makeup and oil without stripping the skin. It has not broken me out and does not irritate my skin or eyes (even when used to remove eye makeup). I like this balm much better than other more irritating and expensive balms I have previously tried.

I ordered this about two months ago. I love this whole skincare routine. I feel super clean with the double cleansing (oil & balm). I do like this product more because I feel it does a great job of cleaning my face. I notice a big difference when I apply makeup. My pores are not as noticeable. What I love about this product is that it helps bring the gunk out more so I can use my extractor tool to further clean out the pores on my nose.

I'm really enjoying this as the 1st step of my 2 step cleanse routine. Removes all of my makeup, including my waterproof mascara, easily. Reasonably priced, which made me less apprehensive about adding another product into my already pricey skincare routine. I'm a skincare nerd and LOVE buying and trying all of the skincare products....this is definitely on my must have list!

this is a good first step cleanse, and this isn't terribly expensive. i do find that i need to work a little harder to get mascara off, but it leaves my skin feeling clean and soft. i'm sensitive to most fragrances, oily/combo skin, but this product hasn't caused any irritation or breakouts. i usually follow this with srb or dhc powder wash, then get into the rest of my skincare routine.

I love this cleansing balm. I've used it for two, three days now and it really helps remove my makeup very well. What I love is that there is no artificial fragrances so the smell is light but natural from the ingredients. There is no alcohol, so it doesn't irritate the skin. I had heavy eye makeup today with glitter and eyelash glue and it took it off gently. I love this!!!

avis.titre: I use this product as a second cleanser
avis.texte: I use this product after washing my face. It is very moisturizing and leaves my face so soft. My pores also look much smaller after using the product.

Loved this product! It feels amazing rubbing the balm away and thoroughly takes off all of my makeup! The salicylic acid in the formula is not at all irritating or overwhelming which is what i was scared of at first. Highly recommend!!
Love this cleanser. It is perfect to remove makeup and the summer sweat. Not an overwhelming smell and nice texture.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: I wasn't so sure about this balm at first because i've never tried a cleanser like it but omg loving this!! Consistency is like that of coconut oil, and it just melts onto your skin. I feel like it really does cleanse everything that I wore on my face, and thoroughly cleans, making my skin feel super smooth after. In a way i feel like it exfoliates as well.. not sure if thats what is advertised but i feel the difference after using this! I don't use it everyday though, maybe twice a week. A mini spatula is included so you don't get it under your nails.

avis.titre: Smooth Cleanser that Removes Light Makeup Easily
avis.texte: I have been trying to find different ways to remove makeup from my skin that is better for the environment by using less cloth waste. Previously, I used makeup wipes, where the material was too harsh on my skin. The Hanskin Pore Cleansing Balm is soothing to the touch and reminds me of firm coconut oil. The strong scent of orange was a bit surprising to me as it was more of a tart, sour smell like grapefruit rather than something a bit lighter and sweet. As someone who wears light skin makeup and easy-to-remove eye makeup, this product was great to use. I would imagine if you wore mascara or water-proof makeup, it wouldn't be as effective. The product design also comes with a slim spoon to help scoop the cleanser. I do enjoy this feature since the cleanser is a bit slippery to collect while keeping it the product clean. Would I buy this again? Honestly, I'm still looking for a better cleanser choice. Overall, it's great for people who wear lighter makeup, enjoy citrus scents, and wants a product better for the environment.

This stuff is great for preventing breakouts. I mostly use it on my back before I shower, and it really does go a long way to preventing blackheads, and loosening up existing ones. Using this once a day has prevented me from breaking out in months. Also, this brand has an AHA cleansing balm if that is more what your skin needs. A quick 15 min internet search informed me that BHAs would be most effective for me.
I use this to take my makeup off and it works very well. It always leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean and prepped for the rest of my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Takes off makeup well & Keeps skin hydrated
avis.texte: I usually use bb cream on a daily basis which can surprisingly be somewhat difficult to take off completely. This cleansing balm takes off the makeup very well. Giving it a 4 star since balms take longer to rinse off, but I'm seeing that my skin is actually more hydrated so it's paying off.

avis.titre: If I loved cleansing balms, I would repurchase:)
avis.texte: I hardly wear makeup now but when I did I used this to take it off and I didn't have to fight to take off my makeup and suncreen which is a plus for me. The scent can be a little strong for some but it didnt bother me too much. I am a big cleansing oil person and that is why I prefer over oils over balms. But this was a good experience.

I have never tried a pore cleansing balm before and I absolutely love it! I was worried it would be heavy because it's a balm but it is actually very light and refreshing. This product is so smooth and soft on the skin. I love using it as a cleanser and a makeup remover. My skin feels so soft and clean after using it. I use it every night to remove my makeup and cleanse my skin all-in-one. I will 100% buy this product again because I love the way it feels on my skin.

avis.titre: Easily and thoroughly removes all my makeup!
avis.texte: This is my first time using a pore cleansing balm and I love it! It completely and so easily removes my makeup which is so nice. My pores feel super clean and my skin feels nourished and super soft after application. I love being able to massage the balm onto my face and how easily it comes off with water. I definitely like using this cleansing balm to remove my makeup over cleansing oils or makeup towelettes. The applicator that comes with the balm is super helpful and a little bit of the product goes a long way! Highly recommend!

I have very oily and acne prone skin and this has been doing wonder for me in the summer months. I do have to remove my eye makeup separately (my mascara is extremely stubborn) but I'm really happy with this product in terms of cleansing and oil control.

I've never used an oil based cleansing balm before, but I really like how it works! I love being able to massage it onto my face to relax in the evenings, and it comes off no problem with water. The scent is a beautifully subtle citrus, just enough to smell fresh. It helps to loosen and remove my makeup, though I still use my regular facial cleanser afterwards (probably more due to force of habit than necessity). I even use it when I haven't worn any makeup, just to help cleanse and calm my pores. This balm somehow cleanses and moisturizes at the same time, leaving my face feeling clean and refreshed. A little goes a long way as well!
I like how this comes in an oil-based form because it does help to remove light makeups. It smells kinda like lemons, but with some herbs. Your face does feel dry after use, but not a tightening dry.

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel clean but won't take off all my makeup
avis.texte: The Hanskin Pore Cleansing Balm helps my face feel refreshed after taking off my makeup, probably because of the chemical exfoliants in it. I like the scent of it (reminds me of the spa) and the sustainable aspect to the product (don't need cotton pads/wipes). At first my face doesn't feel dried out after using it, but after some time it starts to get that skin-tight feeling. The balm does an okay job at removing my face makeup but does nothing to my mascara (KISS ME Heroine Make non-waterproof mascara, which is notorious for not getting removed easily). I still feel the need to double cleanse after, which I would be fine with if only the cleansing balm removed all of my stubborn makeup. I might try using it as my second step instead of the first step in double cleansing to see if it's better that way.

I'm always on the hunt for a great cleansing balm, and I think I found one! Generally speaking, I like balms a lot better than cleansing oils because they're less messy in my personal opinion. Plus there's something really satisfying about watching the balm melt into an oil in the palm of your hands. This cleansing balm melts really nicely in my hands. It's excellent at removing my SPF and doesn't leave my skin feeling over-stripped of it's natural oils. I do feel like you have to use more product to remove a full face of makeup but I usually don't wear a lot of makeup anyways. This product contains BHA which is a fantastic chemical exfoliant for removing dead skin cells without being too much for my sensitive skin. All in all, this is a great first step to my skin routine and I can't wait to try some of the other Hanskin cleansing balms!

avis.titre: Feels great and removes all my makeup
avis.texte: I love using this every night to remove my makeup easily and even on days I dont wear makeup I feel like it's an extra step to deep clean. It literally melts as you rub on dry skin and then washes off easily with foam cleanser. Feels so clean afterwards.

avis.titre: Love this, perfect for all make up!
avis.texte: my first time trying a cleansing balm, as i have been seeing them pop up among many brands. A bit skeptical because I originally thought it would create a greasy feel and get messy when applying. But the directions were to apply on dry skin and let it work, so i did this right before hopping in to the shower and it was perfect! It washed off all my waterproof mascara, and wasn't messy and did not leave any residue behind. It also seemed to help keep my skin moisturized and i love how it doesn't have a overwhelming fragrance!

It is very calm and has a great scent to it. I can apply a small amount and would cover most my face. The balm melts once you use it on your face which is good! I would recommend if you want an effective and calming cleansing balm.

avis.titre: Not for me but it works well
avis.texte: I don't use makeup very often, but I wanted to test the product to see if it really removed all my makeup, and it did! So I know that it works, but I personally couldn't get used to the texture of the cleanser. It's the same texture as coconut oil, so it feels very greasy upon application. The absent fragrance also didn't help make the texture bearable, but after wiping the balm off, my face did feel really soft. It didn't feel like my face was stripped or bare, and it didn't feel dry like how most cleansers make my face feel. I'm giving this product 4 stars because it does work and it honestly makes my face feel really nice after. I just personally don't use makeup enough to make full use of this cleanser, and I couldn't get used to the texture. Overall it's solid!!

avis.titre: Works as makeup remover and cleaners!
avis.texte: Way better than the makeup wipes I've been using for years! This product is so gentle on my skin and keeps it moisturized even as a cleanser. Really appreciate the applicator that is provided because I'd hate to get product stuck inside my finger nails!

I love this product! I use this every single night and it feels so good when lathering. It doesn't leave your fave oily nor dry, so it's perfect for me! You definitely do use more depending on how much makeup you have on. But a fun way to take off your makeup and a fun add to your nightly skincare routine! Definitely would buy this again, but my only problem is plastic packaging. But overall, love it!

avis.titre: Such a great makeup remover and cleanser!
avis.texte: This product is very similar to the famous Clean it Zero make up remover and does an amazing job taking off all of your makeup. I like that the balm feels softer and melts faster as you rub it around your face compared to other balms. After using it for a little over a week, I can noticeably tell that my skin feels smoother!

avis.titre: Not for me, but would recommend!
avis.texte: I tried this product out as I wanted to try something new than my regular basic foam cleansing routine. I found that I broke out a little on my cheeks, but my forehead was flawless. I think my skin may be too dry for this cleansing balm and may be will to try the more sensitive cleansing balm. I also do not wear any makeup which I tried erasing some makeup on my hand and it worked like a charm. Will definitely keep for the rare times I do put on makeup!

avis.titre: Say Bye Bye to Stubborn Makeup and Dead Skin Cells!
avis.texte: I've always had trouble looking for a makeup remover that removes all of my makeup AND is gentle with my skin at the same time. I recently stumbled upon this product and I must say, it has become my go-to! Definitely seen a huge difference and improvement in my skin as the days goes by! Also, for the price, it's definitely affordable and comes in a huge container that will last me awhile.

I have tried numerous cleansing balms, and I prefer this one over others. I have naturally dry skin, this balm is more moisturizing than others I've tried. It melts quickly, seems to do a solid job at removing my multiple layers of sunscreen. I also appreciate the applicator, that way I don't have to use my fingers and I can keep the product clean. Highly recommend, especially for the price.
I use it every day and it doesn't dry my skin and it helps control the natural oil of my skin.

This product is great! It has made my skin feel smoother and helped get rid of the small bumps I used to have. This product has also made my skin glow, which I really love. Lastly, the packaging is great because it comes with a small spatula.

I used this balm mainly to remove all my makeup at the end of the day. It comes with a handy little applicator so you can get just the right amount. A little goes a long way! After massaging it into my skin, it promptly melted off the BB cream/sunscreen I use daily and my eyebrow makeup. I used a charcoal sponge to get all of the product off my face instead of a towel. It did not leave my face dry or irritated afterwards. This product has a light scent which I appreciate in all skincare products. The packaging was just plain ugly, no aesthetic value whatsoever. There are so many great Korean products with great packaging in glass, ie. Cremorlab.

I have super oily, acne prone, and sensitive skin and this produce really does wonders. I break out quite frequent but I noticed after using this product while still using my daily morning/night cleaner, I have seen a huge difference in my acne and little bumps on my forehead.

I like to use this as my first line of makeup removing and cleansing. It melts my eyeliner and mascara off well. It takes a little bit to work through your face and I have to use quite a bit of product to ensure my whole face is covered and all the makeup is worked off. You have to spend some time massaging it in to make the product work well.

avis.titre: GREAT for double cleansing!! Better than an oil!
avis.texte: I have very acne prone skin, oily skin, but dry around the edges of my face. Mainly get breakouts on my chin area and sides of cheeks and the occasionally forehead breakout. I have been searching for a balm cleanser for a while now. Oil cleansers are not the best for everybody and they definitely did not work for me. I saw this had a few great reviews and decided to try it. And I am not disappointed! This product does NOT clog your pores, and leaves my skin feeling so clean! This product did not cause me to break out and has helped me to better clean my skin. I pair this with the CeraVe Foaming Facial Cleanser for even better results. I hope you give this a try!!

avis.titre: Better than the Clinique Cleansing Balm
avis.texte: I really like this product. So much so that I won't go back to Clinique Cleansing Balm. The Clinique cleansing balm would make my eyes feel "blurry" and this product does not do that what so ever. I like that it came with a spatula and the Clinique one did not.

I wasn't sure which balm to order from hanskin since they had different ones targeted towards different skin types but they didn't have one for combo skin. I ended up choosing this one and I love it! It's so gentle and takes off basically everything (followed by my cleanser)

I have struggled with oily skin and clogged pores for many years. I have been using everything from high end to 100% all natural to try and figure out what my skin needed. I tried this on a whim and WOW it's kinda weird how it turns to oil on your face and you would think with oily skin it would be a disaster but my skin has never been better. It's soft and I don't have to worry about excess oil anymore.

This is the best make up remover I've used. It sets my skin up perfect for my daily cleanser. It washes right off and doesn't linger an oily feel to it like the dermologica pre-cleanse. I love it! The best make-up remover I've used.
I use this on dry hands to remove makeup as my first cleanse. It works wonders and really cleans my skin. It's really helped control my oil and acne!

This is a fantastic product! I have oily skin that can be sensitive and have occasional breakouts. The balm goes on very smooth and breaks up eye makeup. I use mascara and tight line. It takes everything off! The balm washes away with water. I do not need to double cleanse. I will definitely repurchase.

This is a really great cleansing balm, my pores are so tight and small now! A lot of my blackheads are gone too. I couldnt stop looking in the mirror! I've tried the one by clinique and elemis as well as other cleansing oils, this one is not only the cheapest but the best! I have dry skin and this is intended for oily or normal, i find it doesn't dry me out at all and my skin is really soft after. I will continue to buy as long as they keep selling this beauty right here. I dont really wear makeup so I cant tell if it will remove it but I assume it would do a good job if I had to take a wild guess. I was a little scared it would break me out and I always get scared trying new products but this hasnt done it! I LOVE THIS BALM. Its BOMB.

I actually really like this. I still am cautious about using it around my eyes but it does an amazing job removing grime and makeup. My pores feel smaller and I don't get a harsh reaction from this product (normally salycilic acid causes me to get a red bumpy rash). It might not be super strong, which may be what some people want in a BHA, but it does exactly what I need it to :)

This is a great cleansing balm and the price is a little cheaper than other brands. It takes off mascara and eyeliner without a problem. It has a barely-there scent to it that I also like. It is like an essential oil smell.

I have been searching for a long time to find a product as affective as this. It melts off all the makeup and leaves your skin feeling great. It unclogged my pores instantly. Please never stop making this product. It will forever be my #1!

For a while I was using the Klavuu pearlsation divine cleansing oil but I found that I could never get all of it off as it would leave residue on my face even after following with my water based cleansing leaving me with more blackheads than I started with. This not only actually washes off my I have seen a significant reduction is blackheads. I was worried about this leaving my skin dry since is for oily/combo skin, but so far I have had no such complaints.
This product does exactly what it says, deeply cleans pores to remove makeup and leaves your skin looking blurred as your pores look visibly smaller. I will continue to repurchase this product.

I've been using the Hanskin BHA pore cleansing oil for a few months. I felt it was just ok and didn't get into my pores as much as I'd like as well as not emulsifying much. I decided to switch over to the balm and after just a week I can't believe what a difference it makes on my skin. Acne is clearer. My skin texture is more even and pores are less visible as well as blackhead control. I love this product so much and will definitely be ordering more.
